description.en: The heavy magazine protects zombie, who is then enraged when it is destroyed.
description.zh: 受到厚重杂志保护的僵尸，当报纸被毁坏时将会发飙。

chat.en: Sunday Edition Zombie REALLY loves the comics section, which is why his rage is so all-consuming when it is torn to tatters before he's finished reading it.
chat.zh: 周刊僵尸非常喜欢杂志里的漫画，这就是他还没看完漫画就被撕成碎片时怒不可遏的原因。

text.en: becomes a flighty zombie once the magazine is destroyed
text.zh: 一旦杂志被毁，将会发了疯似的向前冲去
